narr: A slow moving cold front combined with a highly unstable atmosphere along with tropical moisture to produce slow moving thunderstorms with heavy rainfall. Some of these storms trained over the same areas, resulting in scattered instances of flash flooding. Total rainfall amounts in areas with flash flooding averaged two to four inches.
ev: Report of 6 inches of water crossing Durgon Road and Route 220. Portions of the road have become washed out or impassable.
Six inches of fast moving water from Mill Creek and South Mill Creek was flowing over the intersection of South Mill Creek Road and Durgon Road.
Elkhorn Run was flowing swiftly out of its banks across multiple locations along Elkhorn Run Road. Water was 6 to 8 inches in several locations in and around the Dorcas area.
Jenkins Run was was flowing swiftly out of its banks along Jenkins Run Road. Up to 6 inches of fast moving water was observed near the intersection of US-220 and Jenkins Run Road.
